concept: An exceptionally elegant continuous ribbon forming a clothes hanger with the ribbon end becoming a subtle needle. Horizontal lockup. Geometric humanist sans typography.
A strong circular laundry drum emblem whose negative space forms a crisp folded shirt. Bold contemporary condensed wordmark, horizontal composition.
A sophisticated tailoring atelier emblem: two interlocking bespoke F and T letterforms with a single subtle thread passing through. Editorial serif wordmark.
A memorable folded fabric symbol constructed from three broad cobalt ribbon planes, with a tiny lime seam. Wide refined geometric uppercase wordmark.
A minimal shirt collar icon that also reads as a check mark, strong navy silhouette with one cobalt fold. Confident rounded sans wordmark.
A premium drop of water containing an elegant needle and curved thread in negative space. Clean balanced medium sans wordmark, horizontal.
A circular button symbol with four holes that subtly construct FT, offset lime thread. Beautiful bold typographic wordmark with bespoke spacing.
A single elegant hanger enclosing a small abstract water wave, broad strong strokes, restrained lime accent. Stacked centered contemporary wordmark.
A highly distinctive spool of thread shaped into a capital F beside a tailored T, unified compact emblem. Refined modern slab serif wordmark.
A clean woven textile knot made from two interlocking ribbons, one cobalt one navy, conveying garment care. Lowercase-inspired custom uppercase soft wordmark.
A striking custom typographic FULL TIME logo with the U subtly shaped as a washing drum and a restrained stitch detail, no separate generic icon. Bold Swiss-inspired typography.
A refined shield-like clothing care label, with a geometric shirt fold and a single sparkle carved in negative space. Premium compact sans lettering, strong commercial signage identity.
